title: Electricity in Liquids and Electroplating
summary: Which liquids conduct electricity, and how an electric current can coat an object with a thin layer of metal.

ib.note: Extension: links chemistry and physics (electrolysis in MYP 5 / DP)

cbse.chapter: Previous NCERT edition: Chemical Effects of Electric Current

objectives: I can test whether a liquid conducts electricity and explain why some do (ions).
I can describe how electroplating works and set up the apparatus correctly.
I can explain everyday uses of electroplating.
misconceptions: All water conducts electricity equally (pure water barely conducts).
The object to be plated goes on the positive terminal.
Electroplating paints metal on (it deposits metal atoms).
